params.headline: Ready to launch your women's health supplement line?

params.title: Reach Out to Get Your Women's Health Supplement Line Started

items.answer: Private labeling means you launch a women's health product under your own brand using one of our pre-existing, doctor-formulated stock formulas. We handle production, quality testing, and bottling. You select the formulation from our catalog, design your label, and we produce the finished product ready to ship under your brand. No formulation work, no setup fees, no lab build-out.
items.question: What does private labeling women's health supplements actually involve?

items.answer: Most women's health formulations have minimum order quantities in the low hundreds of bottles per SKU. Once your labels are approved, production typically takes three to four weeks before your first inventory ships. Custom packaging or formulation can extend that timeline. We give you exact MOQs and lead times for the SKUs you select during your consultation.
items.question: What are typical minimums and lead times for women's health products?

items.answer: Both paths are available. Private label means you use our existing women's health formulations as-is and put your brand on them. Custom formulation means our R&D team develops new women's health formulas to your exact specifications, with full proprietary ownership of the result. Custom carries higher minimums and longer timelines but gives you a real moat. Most clients start with private label and add custom formulations once they have traction.
items.question: Can I customize the formulations or only the label?

items.answer: Yes. All our women's health formulations are produced in our FDA-registered, GMP-certified Vermont facility. Our formulations meet dietary supplement labeling requirements under DSHEA. Each batch is tested for identity, potency, and contaminants. You receive Certificates of Analysis with your inventory. We help you understand the structure-function claims you can responsibly make on your label.
items.question: Are these women's health products FDA-compliant?

items.answer: That is where custom formulation comes in. Our R&D team has developed hundreds of women's health formulations over the past 50 years. If your concept is doable within DSHEA and our production capabilities, we can build it. Custom formulation projects typically take 12 to 16 weeks from concept to production-ready, with higher minimums to amortize the R&D investment.
items.question: What if I need a women's health formulation that is not in your catalog?

items.answer: Total launch cost depends on the SKUs you choose, the packaging you select, and the volume you order. Most clients launch a 3-5 SKU women's health line for under $15,000 in initial inventory, including custom label design. There are no setup fees, no annual contracts, and no formulation costs for private label. We provide transparent SKU-by-SKU pricing during your consultation.
